metadata.description: Founder OS — a system of Claude Code skills that takes a solo founder from experience gap to first $1M ARR.

plugins.name: founder-core
plugins.description: Shared foundation: operating principles, the stage map to $1M, the metrics glossary, the ICP schema, writing standards, templates, and the scripts other plugins call. Ships /founder-os:status. Install this first.

plugins.name: discovery
plugins.description: Find and validate the idea (skills 1–3): mine experience gaps, map communities, and prove demand with money/time/access evidence.

plugins.name: product-strategy
plugins.description: Know the market, ship the smallest thing that wins (skills 4–8): market sizing, positioning, MVP scoping, PMF measurement, landing pages.

plugins.name: sales-revenue
plugins.description: Turn attention into money (skills 9–13): offer creation, pricing, cold outreach, first customers, objection handling.

plugins.name: marketing-growth
plugins.description: Predictable attention (skills 14–19): marketing plan, copywriting, SEO content, email campaigns, social media, paid ads.

plugins.name: operations-systems
plugins.description: Get the founder out of the machine (skills 20–24): processize, SOP builder, automation, delegation, hiring.

plugins.name: finance-fundraising
plugins.description: Know the numbers, raise only if you must (skills 25–28): unit economics, financial model, pitch deck, fundraising decision.

plugins.name: leadership-mindset
plugins.description: Run yourself and the company (skills 29–34): company values, minimalist review, sustainable growth, decision frameworks, founder productivity, team building.
